notes: Main experiment data and protocol. Protocol: at most 7 Doctor-Agent collaboration turns with early stopping, the neutral Agent task and system prompt, the turn-independent Doctor decision (as in v7_agentclinic_max7.json; the implementation and the prompts are the same files). Dataset: the frozen version agentclinic_main_v2 (data/splits/agentclinic_main_v2.json): 181 eligible cases, case-level split TRAIN 90 / DEV 31 / TEST 60. Everything of this run is generated here from the Doctor's opening message on: no history, standalone assessment, trajectory, label, predictor, calibration, rubric or weight of an earlier run is read. TEST is not used before the final evaluation: no trajectory, label, rubric, model selection or training touches it.

dataset.selection_notes: eligible = the cases of the frozen dataset version: the Doctor and the Agent hold different information, the Agent holds at least one clinical finding of its own (a physical-examination finding or a test result), and neither side's input states the diagnosis by name, abbreviation or trivial lexical equivalent (scripts/audit_eligibility.py, scripts/freeze_dataset.py). Decided from the raw case content only.

split.notes: the split is read from the dataset manifest; nothing is recomputed

base_trajectories.notes: D1 for every TRAIN and DEV case (histories.jsonl, written once), then one natural collaboration of the base Agent per case with the Agent-side state elicited before every Agent turn; a Doctor output that is not valid JSON is rerun up to max_attempts times

candidates.names_notes: the five fixed candidate responses, generated at every Agent turn a base collaboration reached; the Agent's own assessment in the instruction is the one it held before that turn

smoke.notes: timing and wiring check on a seeded sample of TRAIN cases (all their reached turns); its rollouts are kept and reused by the full run. It decides nothing about the protocol.

integrity.notes: structural checks (K, missing values, split isolation, compliance, pair counts) stop the run; these numbers only catch a plainly broken run. Per-turn counts are reported in turn_sanity_<scope>.json.
